answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a dune seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The mirror receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank thus goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 82 aliases trips the duplicate check at the prism gate. A 464 account operation therefore ties up 3 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
